comparisons.notes: Completed routing and positive setup, but negative hold. Conditional neighboring-fabric contract; no board timing or matched reference route claim. The prior exact-RTL arithmetic oracle is reused without changing its target.

comparisons.name: HOGE input buffering before reset correction
comparisons.notes: Same 4 ns conditional neighboring-fabric I/O window; two physical identity LUT stages per input and output. Full arithmetic oracle reused for identical RTL. No board or extracted-reference route claim.

comparisons.name: YATA with repaired input boundaries
comparisons.notes: Same 4 ns conditional neighboring-fabric I/O window; two physical identity LUT stages per input and output. Full arithmetic oracle reused for identical RTL. No board or extracted-reference route claim.

comparisons.name: HOGE arithmetic-only reset correction before transpose correction
comparisons.notes: Retained setup and hold failure. Worst setup path still runs from reset to transpose data registers; same conditional fabric window and physical input/output buffers.

comparisons.name: HOGE control-only reset before output hold repair
comparisons.notes: Setup meets 4 ns at 0.000 ns slack; eleven output hold failures remain, worst -0.017 ns. Original failed route retained.
